title: Final 02B — napięcie Marianny
description: Krótki ciasny portret Marianny. Początkowy strach i napięcie przechodzą w skupienie, gdy jej wzrok zatrzymuje się na papierowym schemacie auspeksu. To emocjonalny most pomiędzy rozpoznaniem zagrożenia a praktycznym pomysłem obrony.

prompts.image: Photorealistic live-action 16:9 tight 85 mm close-up of Marianna during the same planning-table moment as final-02. Preserve her exact pale face, long white hair, blue eyes, tall slim proportions, black layered RPG-club wardrobe and subtle jewelry from the character reference. Preserve the exact destroyed Klub Fantastyki, warm practical lighting, storm-blue window light and paper auspex diagram continuity from final-02 and the place reference. Frame upper chest to just above her head. Initial fear remains in slightly widened eyes and a tight jaw, but her gaze has just dropped toward the paper auspex diagram below frame and is sharpening into concentrated problem-solving. Only Marianna is in focus; vague shoulders of the group may remain soft background shapes, never new faces. prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second locked close-up, with the decisive beat completed inside the first 0.75 seconds because only the first second is used on the timeline. 0.00-0.25 s: Marianna holds a frightened off-screen stare and takes one shallow breath. 0.25-0.70 s: her eyes drop toward the paper auspex diagram below frame; her jaw relaxes by a trace and fear turns into focused calculation. 0.70-3.00 s: hold the concentrated expression with one natural blink and minimal breathing. Preserve exact identity, hair, skin, black clothing, lighting and club background. No dialogue, head turn, smile, magic, new person, camera movement, cut, morphing, text or watermark.
